//_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your Jellyseerr + WAHA details.

webhook.//_library_comment: Library webhook for Plex / Sonarr / Radarr. When set up, users following a movie or show receive a WhatsApp DM the moment a new episode or movie hits the library. Set 'token' to require a ?token=... query string for authentication (recommended when exposing this endpoint).

mappings.//_userIdMappings_comment: Map WAHA phone numbers to Jellyseerr user IDs. Use phone number without @c.us suffix as key. Each entry must have 'userId' (number) and 'username' (string) properties. LID format (@lid) is automatically resolved to phone number for lookup. Add 'patreonEmail' (string) to link this WhatsApp number to a Patreon account for tier gating; if omitted, the bot falls back to the email it knows from Seerr (emailMappings).
mappings.//_emailMappings_comment: Map email addresses to Jellyseerr user IDs. Automatically populated when webhook notifications are received.
mappings.//_lidMappings_comment: Map phone number format chatIds to LID format chatIds. This allows using LID format (more private) when sending messages. Format: "phoneNumber@c.us": "lidNumber@lid". Mappings are automatically created when LID format messages are received.

commands.//_follow_comment: Comma-separated aliases for the follow command (subscribe to a title without creating a Seerr request).
commands.//_unfollow_comment: Comma-separated aliases for the unfollow command.
commands.//_calendar_comment: Comma-separated aliases for the calendar command (shows upcoming episodes / releases for followed media).

//_patreon_comment: Restricts the bot to Premium / Diamond Patreon supporters. Leave 'accessToken' empty to disable gating entirely. 'help' and admin users always bypass. Generate a Creator's Access Token at https://www.patreon.com/portal/registration/register-clients and paste it here. 'campaignId' is the numeric ID of your Patreon campaign (find it in the URL when editing your campaign). 'allowedTiers' is a case-insensitive list of tier titles that grant access. 'upgradeUrl' is included in the rejection message so non-supporters know where to go. 'refreshIntervalMinutes' controls how often we re-fetch the patron list.
